state.$description: Interaction-state strengths, expressed as opacities rather than baked colors so one set of values works on every surface and in every theme. A consumer composes these with the semantic color it is already using (for example an interactive fill at state.hover.overlay), which keeps state consistent without multiplying per-theme color tokens.

surface-overlay.$description: Gentler wash for large hovered surfaces (rows, tiles) so big areas do not shout.

overlay.$description: Overlay strength while a control is held.
Persistent wash marking the active item. Never the only selection signal — pair it with a non-color cue.

opacity.$description: Content alpha for disabled controls — WCAG-exempt.
Dimming strength behind modals and sheets.
